title: Earliest tunes heard: the rags
summary: The first tunes he heard were rags such as Maple Leaf Rag; he never saw one of them written.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What we played: tunes and repertoire in the early days

blocks.x: I can't tell you about the earliest tunes you remember hearing, either in your home or played by bands.
Oh, the early tunes I heard. Mm-hmm. Well, most of all of them was Rags, I mean.
Mm-hmm. Remember any of the names of them?
Oh, yeah. African Pats, Ophelia Rag, Entertainers Rag, A Few Clothes. Oh, no.
A Few Clothes, I never heard that. Uh-huh.
Uh-huh. Uh, well, Grace and Beauty or Maple Leaf Rag, other rags, most of all of them.
You remember how Few Clothes went, anything about it?
No, I don't know. Mm-hmm. What's going to ask you about it? I wish I did because I never seen it. I never seen it written.
I never have seen Few Clothes in the Island of the Island. No, I haven't seen it. I've seen those others, you know, playing the Red Bull.
No, no, I've never seen that one. I wish I could remember because it's a good rag.
